I'm passionate about storytelling, marketing and product strategy for B2B/B2C solutions that improve people's day-to-day lives.

Hi everyone!

My name is Joshua Shapiro, and I'm excited to throw myself into the product marketing fire at a fast-paced, high-ownership startup. Extra points if you solve problems people face in their day-to-day lives.

Grind at a place like this? I'd love to connect.

I currently work as a Senior Fellow for President Ari Berman at Yeshiva University. If you're not sure what that entails (most people don't), my average day is a mix of ghostwriting for national media publications like the New York Times, editing videos on Adobe Premiere, and managing high profile speaker series with politicians and authors.

Before Yeshiva, I worked as a Content Strategist at ADJ Strategies where I helped C-Suite executives at public companies like Monday.com and Series A-B startups backed by Tier-1 VCs (Tiger, Insight, Bessemer) turn their unique insights and experiences into content that accelerates their GTM and attracts inbound opportunities.

When I'm not reading a marketing blog or building a productivity tool in Claude, I enjoy playing basketball, riffing on my guitar, devouring fiction books, and volunteering as a cantor at my local synagogue.
